description: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the distribution of three categories – Context, Generated Response, and Other – across two conditions: “Ours” and “Standard.” The vertical axis displays the conditions, labeled “Ours” and “Standard” in that order from top to bottom. The horizontal axis represents percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 0% to 100%, and tick labels at 10% intervals. Each condition is represented by a stacked bar composed of three colored segments. For “Ours”, the blue “Context” segment spans approximately 60.6%, the orange “Generated Response” segment spans approximately 31.7%, and the green “Other” segment spans approximately 7.7%. For “Standard”, the blue “Context” segment spans approximately 23.6%, the orange “Generated Response” segment spans approximately 51.1%, and the green “Other” segment spans approximately 25.3%. The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized. A legend at the bottom of the chart indicates that blue represents “Context”, orange represents “Generated Response”, and green represents “Other”.
